text:
Aisha: hey team — I'm finishing up onboarding but I'm stuck on Okta MFA. SMS verification never shows up (I'm in Kenya, +254). anyone seen international SMS issues?

it-support: hey Aisha, welcome! we do see some carriers drop sms sometimes. can you confirm the phone number you added (last 4 digits)?
Aisha: it ends with 4321. used the office wifi and tried cellular, nothing. i can receive normal sms elsewhere.
julie-peopleops: @Aisha fyi we can generate backup codes or do a temporary manual exemption so you can finish onboarding. do you need access to drive/github right away?
Aisha: yes — need access to team drive and the repo to start ramping. also 1Password invite hasn't hit my inbox (i used a personal email on the form by mistake).
carlos: approved temporary access. @it-support please share a view-only link to the team drive and add Aisha to the repo with triage permissions until SSO is working.
it-support: on it. creating a time-limited drive share (48h) and adding a GitHub invite with repo:infra-docs (triage). sending 1Password invitation to Aisha's work email now (aisha@redwood.ai). also we can generate 10 Okta backup codes if SMS still fails.
onboarding-bot: 1Password invite sent to aisha@redwood.ai.
it-support: backup codes generated — I'll DM you the codes now. also as a workaround you can enroll Okta Verify or Google Authenticator (app-based) which is more reliable than SMS.
Aisha: got the drive link, can view! 1Password invite still hasn't appeared in work inbox (checked spam). thanks for generating backup codes — used one and completed the Okta step, i'm in.
julie-peopleops: awesome. when you have a sec, follow the onboarding doc about switching to an authenticator app: https://intranet.redwood.ai/onboarding/authn (section: "Switching from SMS to App"). it covers Okta Verify + recovery codes.
devops: quick note: for GitHub access we'll need your SSH public key to add to your profile. paste the key here or upload to the secure 1Password note.
Aisha: pasted SSH key snippet: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIJ... aisha@redwood.ai
carlos: welcome aboard Aisha :tada: — team intro at 2pm today, we'll walk through docs and current priorities. ping here if anything else blocks you.
Aisha: thank you everyone, really appreciate the quick help! :heart:
